body_html: Liberty’s Way evokes the elegance of a summer night, carried by the luminous softness of orange blossom. A graceful, feminine and magnetic fragrance, leaving behind a refined and irresistible trail.

body_html: Yellow Splash evokes the invigorating freshness of a Mediterranean breeze, between summer days, sunlit shores and a marine sky. A luminous, energetic and refreshing fragrance, designed to leave a vibrant and elegant impression.

title: Passion Oud
body_html: Passion Oud is inspired by the Arab tales of One Thousand and One Nights, between Oriental mystery, spicy warmth and woody elegance. A deep and captivating haute couture fragrance, where oud, rose and amber evoke the magic of Arabian nights.

title: Spice Rose
body_html: Spice Rose transports you to the heart of Istanbul’s vibrant markets, between Ottoman richness, Oriental mystery and the effervescence of spices. An intense and refined fragrance, where rose blends with woody and amber depth to create a captivating trail.

title: Metallic Oud
body_html: Metallic Oud reveals a luminous and unexpected femininity, carried by natural oud from Laos and a radiant amber-woody accord. A contrasting, intimate and delicate fragrance, between surprise, magic and enchantment.

title: My Magic
body_html: My Magic embodies seduction in its most intense form: a deep, gourmand and sensual fragrance, where honeyed warmth meets the richness of tobacco, woods and resins. A powerful, enveloping and confident trail.

title: Leather Effecto
body_html: Leather Effecto opens with a spicy and liqueur-like warmth, before revealing a floral heart dominated by jasmine. In the base, amber, woody and vanilla notes create a deep, sensual and intensely enveloping trail.

title: Golden Ice
body_html: Golden Ice opens with a fresh, lively and tangy fruitiness, before revealing a soft and magnetic floral elegance. Between Turkish rose, peony, vanilla and cashmere warmth, this fragrance expresses a modern, luminous and timeless sensuality.

title: Exquisite
body_html: Exquisite evokes a refined and seductive gourmandise, inspired by Oriental sweets and Ottoman opulence. A vibrant, sophisticated and deliciously addictive fragrance.

title: Tiger’s Eye
body_html: Tiger’s Eye embodies a raw and magnetic strength, inspired by arid landscapes shaped by fire and stone. Like tiger’s eye, this fragrance asserts a warm, masculine and untamable presence, a symbol of courage, power and confidence.

title: Harmonic Tourmaline
body_html: Harmonic Tourmaline celebrates the sacred harmony between bees and flowers, a symbol of interdependence and natural balance. Inspired by the many reflections of tourmaline, this fragrance evokes a luminous, living and deeply soothing nature.

title: Wild Emerald
body_html: Wild Emerald evokes a journey through the heart of dense, fertile and untamed nature. Inspired by emerald, this fragrance celebrates the power of the earth, the vitality of forests and the wild elegance of green landscapes.

title: Ethereal Moonstone
body_html: Ethereal Moonstone evokes the mysterious elegance of the night, between lunar freshness, woody depth and discreet sensuality. Inspired by moonstone, this fragrance reveals an enigmatic, refined and magnetic aura.

title: Fleur De Tabac
body_html: Fleur de Tabac is a fragrance that masterfully balances balsamic sweetness and vanilla with a drier masculinity. It offers a captivating experience, transforming the wearer into a man of mystery and intrigue.

title: Radiant Peridot
body_html: Radiant Peridot evokes the luminous energy of a tropical paradise, between lush nature, radiant fruits and solar warmth. Inspired by peridot, this fragrance celebrates vitality, joy and renewal.

title: Velvet Morganite
body_html: Velvet Morganite evokes the softness of a secret garden bathed in sunlight, where love reveals itself with tenderness, intimacy and delicacy. Inspired by the rosy peach glow of morganite, this fragrance celebrates a velvety, luminous and deeply soothing femininity.
